theorem_level_results.boundary_hit_separation: For X>38, if two distinct scaled decimal-boundary hits inside (X,X+19) occur n steps apart, then X<=171*3^n.
theorem_level_results.exact_boundary_coincidences: The only equal scaled-boundary hits at different times are 2->3, 4->6, 6->9 at gap 1 and 4->9 at gap 2.
theorem_level_results.phase_residue_reduction: On a horizon with no scaled boundary hit, PR #17 forces the actual digit word to equal the homogeneous (3/2)^t digit word; exact-r=1 survival then reduces to the established single terminal 2-adic residue congruence.

interpretation: PR #17 showed that observed positive post-lock tails through B=220 are phase-frozen. This increment proves a scale-aware separation law for the exceptional boundary-hit times and turns phase-frozen blocks into direct 2-adic residue certificates. It still does not give a uniform F(B) or F(M) tail bound.
